method: Prototype pass, no renames: every proposal repeats the CURRENT applied name (cataclysm_gog_r5a functions.csv, after D1) with kind function and a signature. Scope (a): real-named functions (tools/binary_map_coverage.py tier "real") whose latest apply status over the r1..r4 cet_apply_report.csv files is no-proto: 1,821 (won 727, cat-new 357, crt 332, hw1 249, lib 105, unknown 41, bink 7, rgl 3); hw1:* ones go to Game-a-f/g-m/n-s/t-z by HW1 file name, the rest to Ships-other; cat-new ones only by the body; won/crt/lib/unknown/bink/rgl not attempted (no HW1 declaration; bink/rgl have none in HomeworldSDL). (b) r3-deferred-sigs: the 186 C1-created functions of ghidra/proposals/r3/reconcile_deferred_functions.json (107 with an audited signature, used as the first candidate; the HW1 declaration is a second candidate; the other 79 by their HW1 declaration). (c) degraded-unparsed: the 46 entries still proto-applied-degraded and the 2 proto-unparsed round-1 entries (their symbol type is free text, so the HW1 declaration is used). (d) d1: the 54 D1-created functions (ghidra/proposals/r4/reconcile_deferred_functions.json, 33 audited signatures + HW1 declarations); FUN_00528580 found by D1 is unnamed, so skipped. Declaration source and translation as round 4 (prototypes-r4): HomeworldSDL .c definition, .h prototype, gardens-of-kadesh, CET decl, CET-commented decl (capped medium); types kept only if present in r5a datatypes.h (bool->sdword in C, HW1-only enums->sdword, HW1-only fn-pointer typedefs/inline fn ptrs/struct ptrs->void *). Binary checks (objdump -d -M intel of original/game/cataclysm.exe, function starts from r5a): RET imm (0 -> __cdecl, == arg bytes -> __stdcall, else dropped), caller cleanup (add esp,N / pop ecx after each direct call), pushes before each direct call, r5a decompiled.c body (in_stack_ reads beyond the args, Ghidra-found param bytes > declared, pointer/float use per param). NEW in r5: (1) merged cleanup: when the only contradiction is callers cleaning MORE than the args (add esp merged over several calls) and every direct site pushes exactly the declared args, the declaration is kept (capped medium). (2) ETG function table: the table at 0x0087980c-0x0087aa34 in .data (167 entries of 0x1c bytes: char *name, fn, ret code | passThis<<8, resolve fn, nParams byte + one type byte per param: 1 int, 2 float, 3/4 colour) lists 162 functions; etgFunctionCall 0x0046e7b0 builds a local array (effect first when passThis) and calls "call [ebx+4]" with ONE pushed pointer, "add esp,4", storing EAX. So every table function is "<ret> __cdecl f(T *args)" (one elem: T = HW1 param type, named after it, as round 4 did for partSetScale(real32 *n); several: T = the common HW1 type, else udword); checked: RET 0 or tail jmp, no direct callers, Ghidra <=1 param, highest index read < elem count. HW1 float-returning ETG fns return udword (fstp/mov eax), kept. (3) arity-extended (low): HW1 declares fewer args than Cataclysm passes; only when all >=2 direct sites push the same count p, Ghidra found exactly p 4-byte params, no site cleans less, RET 0, and the HW1 param kinds (ptr/int/float) agree with the body on the first N; extra params typed from the body (cat_argK). (4) cat-new body-derived: Ghidra param list kept when RET imm (stdcall) equals its bytes, or (cdecl) >=2/3 of direct sites push exactly that count, no site cleans less, at least one cleans exactly that (or merged), no in_stack_ read beyond; functions with no direct callers only with a matching RET imm; types: /Cataclysm types Ghidra propagated from callees kept, float->real32, undefined4/int->sdword, uint->udword, 1-byte->ubyte, untyped pointers->void *; return undefined->void only if the body returns nothing; low when 1 site or most types are placeholders. (5) cat-new callbacks with no direct caller, typed by the HW1 typedef of the table the naming evidence names: FE {fn,name} tables -> FEFlow.h fefunction void(char *name, featom *atom) or, for *Draw names, fedrawfunction void(featom *atom, regionhandle region); script entries -> StatScript.h setVarCback void(char *directory, char *field, void *dataToFillIn); nisEventDispatch slots -> NIS.h niseventdispatch void(nisplaying*, nisevent*) as void *; cmdline entries -> SDL/main.h bool32 (*function)(char *string); only with RET 0, Ghidra stack params <= the typedef count, no float where a pointer is expected, no in_stack_ read beyond. (6) degraded-unparsed: when the r5a body is garbled by a big _chkstk frame (in_stack_ offsets 0xe4..0x3fxx) the arity is taken from caller cleanup only: add esp/pop == HW1 arg bytes at >=2 sites (or 1 site + matching push count) keeps the HW1 declaration (medium); a larger consistent cleanup at >=2 sites appends sdword cat_argK extras (low). The 2 unparsed round-1 entries had free text as type, so the HW1 declaration replaces it. Drops: any standard proposal whose only doubts are arity/cleanup flags (round-4 audit: such low entries were wrong), the 2 prototypes the round-4 audit sampled wrong (0x00404090 aieCheckEnemyNearby, 0x00567750 mrDockingOrders), the *_tail chunks (no own frame), and a cat-new HW1-lookalike declaration with any doubt (falls back to the body). RET imm == declared bytes on a cdecl HW1 decl (window procs) -> __stdcall, counted as support. Confidence: high = >=2 agreeing stack facts and no contradiction, capped at the name confidence; one weak contradiction -> low; any strong one -> dropped. Every signature has an explicit __cdecl/__stdcall/__fastcall(pThis, edx_unused, ...) and only type names present in r5a datatypes.h; a clang -fsyntax-only check against the A2 header prelude (round-3 sigcheck.c) flags only AITeamMove (in the r5a DTM, absent from that prelude) and C++ bool (Ghidra built-in).
